_comment: 0.4*200 + 0.3*200 + 0.2*200 + 0.1*200 = 200. Score is strictly below 300, but confidence (1/4 = 250) is not greater than 900, so the REJECT branch does NOT fire and the proposal falls through to CONDITIONAL. Protects against the agent auto-rejecting when the data is too thin to support a confident reject.
